svg.title: Yeouiju 08 / vivid nacre, original dragon palette
svg.desc: Original vivid dragon, pearl and motto colors and contours restored and preserved. Surrounding cloud, water and border inlays match the dragon palette and fragment scale. Subtle shell grain and localized reflections add material detail without muting the original colors. Native SVG without embedded raster images.

svg.title: Mother-of-pearl Korean dragon with Seokbong-calligraphy nacre motto
svg.desc: Python-generated multi-part vector dragon and vertical right-to-left motto, with no embedded raster or live text.
svg.metadata: motto:萬物相通/用之甚易 layout:vertical-rtl style:seokbong-calligraphy-hand-cut-dragon-matched-nacre tessellation:deterministic-voronoi shell-lamellae:vector-only glyph-outline-source:Seokbong-Cheonjamun-scan public-domain

g.desc: 萬物相通 in the right column and 用之甚易 in the left column, both top to bottom.
